name: 2,3-dinitrotoluene to 3-methoxyphenol
summary: A 7-step route from 2,3-dinitrotoluene to 3-methoxyphenol, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: 4-methyl-5-nitrocatechol 5-monooxygenase
reactions.equation: 4-methyl-5-nitrocatechol + NADPH + O2 = 2-hydroxy-5-methylquinone + nitrite + NADP(+) + H2O + H(+)

reactions.name: 3-amino-2-hydroxy-4-methoxybenzoate diazotase
reactions.equation: 3-amino-2-hydroxy-4-methoxybenzoate + nitrite + ATP = cremeomycin + AMP + diphosphate + H2O

relations.note: Shares 2,4-dinitrotoluene with alliin to S-allylsulfenic acid.
Shares dinitrogen with hydrazine to nitrate.
Shares dinitrogen with methyl sulfate to S-formylmycothiol.
